agent-shell - terminal-native AI agent

Commands:
  credential claim <id>           Claim a credential and start the agent (switchable anytime)
  credential drop                 Release the credential and stop the agent
  agent help                      Show this help
  agent unload                    Unload agent-shell, restore the original shell
  agent debug tail                Follow the debug log (tail -f)
  agent debug cat                 Print the debug log (cat)

Keybindings:
  Ctrl+G  Pause/resume the agent
  Ctrl+T  Retry the last API request

Env:
  AGENT_API_KEY                   (required) API key
  AGENT_BASE_URL                  API endpoint
  AGENT_MODEL                     Model name
  AGENT_EXEC_DELAY=2              Seconds before auto-executing commands
  AGENT_OUTPUT_MAX_LENGTH=10000   Max tool output length (chars)
  AGENT_DEBUG=false               Debug logging
  AGENT_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0            Command execution timeout (seconds, 0=off)
  AGENT_REASONING_EFFORT=high     Reasoning depth
  AGENT_API_TTFT_TIMEOUT=120      Time-to-first-token timeout (seconds)
